notes.note: useAgentsViewModel.ts changed how the Agents editor reacts to a selection change (it resets per-record form state, asks for a fresh detail read, leaves the unsaved-changes decision to the route guard, and settles a save only on the visit it started from). The document's only claim about this file is that the editor reads the Agent tool catalog through useAgentToolsQuery; that call and its enabled condition are unchanged. No route, request or response shape changed.
